messages:
aj: Heads up — after the Cilium 1.20.3 rollout to west2-gpu we're seeing intermittent pod-to-pod failures for large payloads (gRPC + some RDMA jobs). Errors spike around 99th pct latency and a bunch of short ibv_rc_disconnect events.

maria: Is this across all nodes or just the canary pool?

aj: All GPU nodes in west2 that were on the new agent. Canary was fine but when we pushed to the rest it popped.

len: Any packet captures? MTU / fragmentation suspects?

aj: grabbed tcpdump on pod eth0 and host cilium_host on one affected node:

```
17:02:11.123456 IP pod-abc.grpc > pod-def.grpc: Flags [P.], seq 1:4097, ack 1, win 65535, length 4096
17:02:11.123457 IP host-router > pod-def.grpc: frag 1/2: proto UDP, length 1500
17:02:11.123458 IP host-router > pod-def.grpc: frag 2/2: proto UDP, length 1500
```

aj: But the second fragment never shows up at the pod interface; host shows drop with kernel message: `tc: gso_size (4096) > dev->mtu (1500) — dropping`.

jyoti: That looks like large segment offload/GSO handling changed. Cilium 1.20 introduced a change in the eBPF path and `gso` handling for tunnel devices. Maybe the new code isn't reassembling on the right side for geneve/overlay?

ops_lead: Deploy bot shows the rollout timeline:

sre-bot: deploy-bot: cilium/1.20.3 rolled to west2-gpu nodes 03/22 02:51-03:18 UTC (canary->full).

maria: Any quick mitigation other than full rollback? Can we set per-node `net.ipv4.ip_no_pmtu_disc=1` or flip off host GSO for the tunnel?

len: Short-term we can disable tunnel GSO on host interfaces: `ethtool -K cilium_host gso off gro off tso off` — that will increase CPU but should stop fragment drops. I tested on one node and pod-to-pod large requests recovered.

aj: Confirmed — toggling off GSO/GRO on cilium_host made the ibv jobs complete again on test node. Latency returned to normal P50/P95.

jyoti: Opening an issue with Cilium upstream, looks like a regression around tunnel checksum/gso boundary when conntrack offload + host reassembly are both enabled. Will paste repro steps.

maria: Please also add a note to the incident runbook and tag platform-schedule. We need a rollback if we see more customer impact.

ops_lead: Action items:
- jyoti: file GH issue + link to packet captures and dmesg (ETA 2h)
- len: rollout GSO disable as nodal daemonset patch to affected pool (ETA 30m)
- aj: throttle canary stop further cilium upgrades in other regions (done)
- maria: notify support & mark incidents channel if customers start to page (pending)

sre-bot: alert: pod-network-errors-west2 increased 4.2x since 03:00 UTC.

aj: I'll also schedule a revert to 1.19.8 in the morning if upstream doesn't have a fix tonight. For now applying ethtool knobs on west2-gpu nodes.
